reviews.text: The best bath ever, plus super loving professionals who are passionate about animals!
The team is extremely attentive and qualified. I trust them 100%, from consultations to pet shop services.

The service at Brad Boutique is excellent! The veterinarians and the service and grooming teams are all very careful and attentive to my dogs and to me as well, always supportive partners!!! I recommend them without hesitation!
Excellent! Great service, staff, and atmosphere.

Rachel, thank you so much for the five stars and for your kind words! ❤️

It's very special to receive your recognition. We are happy to know that we had the opportunity to provide a positive experience!

Thank you for your trust and we hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you again. A warm hug from the entire Brad Pet team! 🐾❤️

Hello Henrique!

What a surprise to receive your 1-star review! Even more surprising is that we couldn't find any record of your service or visit to Brad Pet.

It seems we managed the feat of causing a negative experience without even having had the opportunity to serve you!

In any case, if you did use any of our services, we would be happy to receive information that allows us to identify what happened.

After all, we take our customers' opinions very seriously—especially those who actually know our work.

Brad Pet Team

Gabriel, thank you so much for the five stars! ❤️

It's a joy to receive your recognition and know that your experience at Brad Pet was positive. Our team puts a lot of care and dedication into everything we do, and reviews like yours make our work even more rewarding!

Thank you for your trust and we hope to welcome you many more times. A warm hug from the entire Brad Pet team! 🐾❤️
Great place! Our pet loves everyone and gets so excited whenever he goes to daycare or hotel!

I was seen by the veterinarians, Dr. Talita and Dr. Nathan, who were very attentive and caring. They are wonderful, and I am very grateful for the always wonderful service from the entire Brad team. Congratulations (Márcia, the manager...) for having such a wonderful team!!!
